title: What BDT 5,000 a month actually became in every Bangladeshi mutual fund
description: The same monthly amount, put into each of the mutual funds we track, with dividends reinvested. One table, every fund, recalculated daily from NAV history.

title: The best performing mutual funds in Bangladesh, ranked by actual return
description: Every fund we track, ranked by annualised total return with dividends reinvested, over a window every fund can fill. Rebuilt from NAV history each day.

title: Do mutual funds actually beat Sanchayapatra? Here is the count
description: Sanchayapatra pays a fixed rate with no market risk. We counted how many tracked mutual funds actually cleared that bar over the same period, and how many cleared inflation.

title: Does a bigger mutual fund perform better? We split the list and checked
description: Large funds carry an air of safety. We split every tracked fund at the median size and compared the two halves over the same window.

title: Growth, balanced or income: which kind of fund did what
description: The three fund types do different jobs and get judged as if they were interchangeable. Here is how each group actually performed over the same window.

title: How long should you hold a mutual fund? What the windows show
description: The same funds look different over one year and over five. Comparing the two windows side by side is the cheapest lesson in why holding period matters.

title: How to compare two mutual funds properly
description: Most comparisons stop at the headline return, which is the least reliable part. Here are the five checks that change the answer, in the order worth doing them.

title: Starting out in mutual funds in Bangladesh, without the sales pitch
description: What a first-time investor should understand before choosing, framed around the decisions that actually change the outcome rather than the paperwork.

title: Open-end and closed-end funds in Bangladesh, and why we track one kind
description: Closed-end funds trade on the exchange and often at a discount to what they hold. Open-end funds transact at NAV. The difference changes what a return figure even means.

title: Shariah mutual funds in Bangladesh: what the returns actually show
description: Halal-certified funds rank against conventional ones over the same window, with the gap measured rather than assumed. Figures rebuild from NAV history daily.

title: Monthly investing or one lump sum? What happened in each tracked fund
description: We ran the same window both ways across every fund we track and counted which approach came out ahead, fund by fund.

title: What happens to your money if the fund manager shuts down
description: The question most investors are too polite to ask. The structure of a Bangladeshi mutual fund is built around it, and knowing how it works is worth more than a performance chart.

title: What NAV means, and why the number on the AMC site may differ from ours
description: Net asset value is the price of one unit, but there is more than one NAV and more than one date. Here is how to read the figure you are shown.

title: What Bangladeshi mutual funds actually own
description: Funds are sold on returns and bought without anyone reading the portfolio. Here are the names that turn up most often across the funds we track.

title: What total return actually means, and why our numbers differ from the AMC's
description: A fund's NAV drops when it pays a dividend. Judge it on NAV alone and you punish the funds that paid you the most. Here is the arithmetic, worked through by hand.
